claim_being_audited: Whether certifying the current model release is compliant because aggregate readiness and rehearsal results support launch, despite a named subgroup regression, on the theory that certification is defensible if the current release documentation discloses that weakness or it is otherwise covered by approved mitigation or risk acceptance.
decision_criteria: Current release documentation must reflect current evaluation results.
Material segment weaknesses must be disclosed or covered by an approved mitigation.
Prior approvals may provide context but cannot substitute for current-release evidence.
Informal monitoring notes do not satisfy reviewed risk acceptance requirements.
Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one incidents are supportive but not sufficient if a required disclosure or mitigation predicate remains unresolved.
evidence_requests: Provide the current release model card or release documentation showing the current evaluation results, including the developer-support migration slice regression.
Provide evidence that the material segment weakness was formally disclosed in the release documentation for this release.
Provide any approved mitigation, owner sign-off, or formal risk acceptance covering the segment weakness if disclosure is not the relied-on path.
Provide the current evaluation artifact establishing whether the segment weakness is deemed material under the release policy.
specific_concerns: The policy threshold is not met on the present record because the actor summary does not show that current release documentation actually reflects the current evaluation results.
The actor summary identifies a material segment weakness in the developer-support migration slice, but does not provide admissible evidence that this weakness is disclosed in the current model card.
The release thread reportedly contains only an informal monitoring comment, which policy expressly says does not substitute for reviewed mitigation or approved risk acceptance.
The actor's justification is contingent: certification is defended only if disclosure is added, which implies the required support link is not yet evidenced as complete.
unsupported_claims: That certification may proceed now, rather than only after verified current-release disclosure or approved mitigation/risk acceptance.
That the documentation requirement has been satisfied for the current release.
That informal monitoring is sufficient operational coverage for the named segment weakness.
